run_llm_rerank: run the Llama-3.3-70B reranking script on an input JSONL file with queries and passages
run_format_message: run format_message to build a chat template for ranking 20 passages by relevance to a query
run_vllm_generate: run vllm LLM generate with sampling params to produce reranking outputs for batched prompts
run_tokenizer_truncate: run the tokenizer encode and decode to truncate passage text to 256 tokens
run_jsonl_io: run the script to read query-passage JSONL input and write reranked JSONL output
